short.es: Puertas y tapas de polímero marino que no se pudren.
short.en: Marine polymer doors and hatches that won't rot.

intro.es: Puertas, tapas y paneles cortados en Starboard, un polímero marino que no se pudre ni se hincha con el agua. A la medida de tu bote.
intro.en: Doors, hatches and panels cut from Starboard, a marine polymer that won't rot or swell with water. Made to fit your boat.
